newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Soccer-Musonda recalled after three-year gap.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Musonda recalled after three-year gap.

text.p: Belgian-based midfielder Charles Musonda is set to make his first appearance for Zambia in more than three years after being named in a 24-man squad for the African zone World Cup qualifier against South Africa in Lusaka on January 11.

The 27-year-old Anderlecht player has made a miracle recovery from a knee injury which saw him retire prematurely two years ago and is one of a number of key changes in the Zambian squad after their defeat by Congo in November.

Stand-in coach Freddie Mwila, who has taken over from dismissed Dane Raoul Poulsen, has also named veteran captain Kalusha Bwalya and the 21-year-old Manchester City midfielder Jeff Whitley in his squad.
Bwalya, who plays in Mexico, missed Zambia's surprise 1-0 defeat by the Congolese in the opening game of group three.
Whitley, who was born in Zambia but is a British citizen, faces a race against time to obtain dual nationality ahead of the match against the African champions.
Goalkeepers - Collins Mbulo (Mufulira Wanderers), Davis Phiri (Kabwe Warriors), James Phiri (Zanaco)

Defenders - Dabid Chilufya (Konkola Blades), Aggrey Chiyangi (Power Dynamos), Harrison Chongo (Al Tuum, Saudi Arabia), Allan Kamwanga (Mufulira Wanderers), Elijah Litana (Al Hilal, Saudi Arabia), Hilary Makasa (Roan United), Mordon Malitoli (Nkana FC) Jones Mwewa (Power Dynamos)
Midfielders - Joel Bwalya (Cercle Brugge, Belgium), Kalusha Bwalya (America, Mexico), Nicholas Bwalya (Roan United), Charles Musonda (Anderlecht, Belgium), Vincent Mutale (Mufilura Wanderers)

Strikers - Jonson Bwalya (FC Kriens, Switzerland), Tenant Chilumba (AmaZulu, South Africa), Edward Kangwa (Zanaco), Denis Lota (Witbank Aces, South Africa), Kenneth Malitoli (Al Ittifaq, Saudi Arabia), Mwape Miti (Power Dynamos), Andrew Tembo (Zamsure, Jeff Whitley (Manchester City, England)
